scoring_justification: Recomputing the hyperfine constants from raw integrals inside the verifier is infeasible; result-level comparison against the paper-reported experimental constants with a tolerance is the appropriate check.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference for isotropic (A_s) and anisotropic (A_p) hyperfine constants.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Experimental values reported by Madrid et al., Phys. Rev. B 31, 5657 (1985), as quoted in the source paper (Section I: A_s=33.82 MHz, A_p=7.82 MHz).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from the manuscript; the same numbers are reproduced by the reference solve.sh.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual measured quantities the paper aims to reproduce; fabricated gold would defeat the purpose of verification.

A_p.description: Total anisotropic transferred hyperfine constant (sum of σ and π dipolar contributions)

schema.description: Hyperfine constants computed by the static two‑center three‑electron model for the Mn²⁺–F⁻ pair at R=2.58 Å.

outputs.description: Contains the computed isotropic hyperfine constant A_s and the total anisotropic hyperfine constant A_p. The checker compares these values against a hidden reference with an appropriate tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Only the static part of the theory is reproduced; the soft‑phonon contribution is excluded because it requires an experimentally deduced matrix element that is not derivable from the published first‑principles workflow.

steps.description: Score the reported A_s and A_p against the experimental gold values. Each constant earns 1.0 if |value - gold| ≤ 0.10 * |gold|, else 0.0. Final reward is the average of the two sub‑scores.
